All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Card
Represents a single playing card in the Cincuentazo game.
CardImageLoader
Utility class for loading card images from the application's resource directory.
CardInteractionAdapter
Adapter class for CardInteractionListener that provides empty default implementations for all card interaction events.
CardInteractionListener
Listener interface for card interaction events in the Cincuentazo GUI.
CardTest
Unit tests for the Card class.
Deck
Represents the deck of cards used in the Cincuentazo game.
DeckTest
Unit tests for the Deck class.
EmptyDeckException
Checked exception thrown when the deck runs out of cards and the table pile does not have enough cards to be recycled.
GameAlreadyOverException
Unchecked exception thrown when a game action is attempted after the game has already ended in the Cincuentazo game.
GameController
Main controller for the Cincuentazo game screen.
GameModel
Central model class for the Cincuentazo game.
GameModelTest
Unit tests for the GameModel class.
GameModelTest.RecordingObserver
Test double implementation of GameObserver that records which notification methods were called during a test.
GameObserver
Observer interface for reacting to game state changes in the Cincuentazo game.
GameOverController
Controller for the game-over screen of the Cincuentazo game.
GameResult
Utility class that stores the name of the winning player to be displayed on the game-over screen.
GameSettings
Utility class that stores the number of machine players selected in the main menu for use by the game controller.
GameStage
Utility class that centralizes JavaFX stage and scene management for the Cincuentazo application.
InvalidCardPlayException
Checked exception thrown when a player attempts to play a card that would cause the table sum to exceed 50 in the Cincuentazo game.
MachineTurnRunner
Handles the full turn sequence for a machine player in the Cincuentazo game using two background threads to simulate thinking and drawing delays.
MachineTurnRunner.OnTurnFinished
Functional interface used to notify the controller when a machine turn ends.
Main
Entry point of the Cincuentazo JavaFX application.
MainMenuController
Controller for the main menu screen of the Cincuentazo game.
Player
Represents a player in the Cincuentazo game, either human or machine.
Rank
Represents the rank of a playing card and its base game value in the Cincuentazo card game.
Suit
Represents the four suits of a standard playing card deck used in the Cincuentazo game.
